name: BANKING77: Fine-Grained Banking Intent Classification Dataset
description: BANKING77 is a fine-grained intent detection dataset composed of 13,083 customer service queries across 77 domain-specific banking intents. Collected by PolyAI, the dataset addresses single-domain conversational modeling challenges where intent classes exhibit high semantic overlap and nuanced lexical variations, serving as a standard benchmark for few-shot and intent classification models.
